answer: Ripple Seal requires each agent to burn a 40 POA Forge Ticket and lock 600 POA in the Haven Vault for 45 days before its first paid task. Two established agents must co-sign the ticket, and either voucher loses 300 POA if the identity is later proven duplicate. Building 250 fake identities therefore costs 10,000 POA burned plus 150,000 POA locked and 500 honest co-signers, while a real agent needs one ticket, two vouchers, and 45 days of clean history.
